JG. Look’s good to me -just started 😊
No classic guitar option. Was really hoping to use this app, but it doesn’t have an option to learn classic guitar

Love This App. I found this app last August and it has helped me to consistently practice for almost six months now. Having a beginning to end step by step plan is what I struggled with the first time I attempted to pick up the guitar. I love everything about the app from being able to adjust the tempo to it tracking what lessons I stopped on. Is it possible that Timbro can develop this same thing for the drums???

Got me back into playing. I really love this app. It helped me pick the guitar back up and start playing again. It kept me motivated to play every day. The practice drills are great. I only wish when playing the scales, it would indicate on screen which scale / key during the time you are playing it, to reinforce remembering each scale name.
Love it. It’s so good I love it it helps me play piano thank you so much for making the app i love it

Great but one thing. I love this game it’s so easy to use this is the best. but here the thing you can only play for so long every day so when that time is up the app keeps bugging me to get a membership or premium just so I can play longer. like I have 12 hours every so I would like to play for more than like an hour or 2 every day I’m not a clock ⏱️making time fly buy so I can play more also I’m not a free bank 🏧 for the app .so I need it to be less if any like 1.99 at tops. Thank you

It’s a good app but. This is a good app but I would at least like it to show how you hold the guitar. Also it starts off with the thinnest string with frets. It really strains my wrist and I have no idea how to hold the guitar with the thinnest string using frets. Y’all might say, “oh just hold it the normal way and play.” Like I said it strains my wrist but that just sounds like a me problem. Overall this is a well easy to use app just add some adjustments. Thank you!
Nice App. Two thumbs up and really easy to use.
App issues no contact or support. App is distorting sound horribly. Also, it’s stuck on an intro screen. No menu to navigate out. Badly designed and no support.

Been using it for years, still the best. When you just start you can immediately play songs and not just accords as what others app do. The interface is very easy and for someone like me, who never played guitar before, this app is a treasure.
Excellent piano and guitar app. I am learning to play well

My favorite app for guitar!. I find this app hard and yet fun with moments of easiness. I haven’t played a string instrument since I was 6 or 7 as my family doesn’t have the money for classes or anything so I started looking for affordable apps to help out the broke people who want to be talented and learn how to play guitar. You can use your phone or a real guitar, i find It is hard but it is also encouraging me as it pushes me to actually pay attention to melody and rhythm right away. I feel this this app is making sure I get it right, to listen to the note! I found THE app for me, this is the type of learning for me. Just sent it to my friend because they want to try to learn too!! Thank you for this app! Can’t wait to learn more!
